findings.title: Do not record A911-01 as PASS while its required whole-gate disposition is NOT_READY
findings.body: This completion record marks the whole original gate PASS with no open issues, but the supplied current gate remains `not-accepted` and requires an explicit fresh disposition of all eight original findings. Several retain open states and are specifically associated with A911-01; the record neither determines their current relevance to the ten-family declaration nor supplies a resolution. The stated limits preserve those findings, which conflicts with an empty `openIssues` and PASS verdict. Keep this record NOT_READY (or omit it) until that disposition supports closure.

overall_explanation: WHOLE_A91101=NOT_READY; sourceAccuracy=NOT_READY; readerUsability=NOT_READY; quality=NOT_READY; ORIGINAL_FINDING_DISPOSITION=NOT_READY.
